Recorded claim:
Windows nsIFile.fileSize can be cached after a rewrite. Entry309 clones before the final read and tests reported sizes with IOUtils.stat instead of the same cached API. Current compactor moved to MboxCompactor.cpp and reads original/compacted files before renaming, with a clone at SetupPaths; the independent test oracle remains. Explain the platform cache and bug reference in the workaround comment so a later cleanup does not remove it without checking the contract.
